name: Force 05D — Opbouw
label: PULSE 05D / OPBOUW
description: Het linker deel van de R begint als herkenbare vierkante pixels en gaat over in een strak woordmerk. De R blijft even hoog als de andere letters; de i krijgt één oranje pixel.
prompt:
Edit this Force 05C moodboard into a fourth logo variation titled "PULSE 05D / OPBOUW", landscape 1536x1024. The user specifically asks for a logo that goes from PIXELATED to NORMAL. The transition must be IN THE WORDMARK ITSELF, not only the background graphics.
Large hero logo: custom integrated R as the FIRST LETTER of revive. Its leftmost third is built from clearly visible square pixel blocks precisely within the R silhouette; those pixels resolve from coarse/stepped left edge into a smooth solid right half of the same R, followed by perfectly crisp solid "evive". Read left to right: pixelated R leading edge -> structured R -> clean normal letters. Predominantly solid R bowl and short clear diagonal lower-right leg remain fully recognisable. A small restrained handful of pixels may sit immediately at the left edge but never scatter far away or below baseline. The logo must remain bold, readable and purposeful, not broken/glitchy.
CRITICAL LETTER SIZE: R's visible top and baseline EXACTLY match e/v body height. Not as tall as the i dot. R is no wider than 1.15 e widths and matches the others' stroke weight and italic lean. Exactly six letters: R-e-v-i-v-e. No separate monogram preceding an extra r. Retain Force's strong extended italic letters for evive. Name revive only, no capital.
Main logo is offwhite on black, with ONE orange solid square dot above i. The i dot is a clean single square/pixel here, not the three-pixel cluster of the source. Same single square in every logo. On offwhite ground logo is carbon with orange dot. Mono specimen is entirely one ink, including dot and pixels. Show same pixel-to-solid R in large hero, smaller wordmark specimen, app/website and proposal; isolated R icon uses same construction. Include a sizeable close-up specimen of the first R transition so the pixel-to-normal idea is unmistakable even when viewing the full moodboard.
Keep orange/black/offwhite/burgundy palette and labels exactly: Carbon #171719, Oranje #F46529, Papier #F5EEE4, Bordeaux #742D43. Preserve existing Force human workshop/adviser photography, square-pixel motion graphics, GT Eesti Display supporting type, icon family, three-step financing process, desktop/mobile financing interface and proposal cover. Full moodboard, not only logo. No cars. Remove stray decorative text on walls.
Keep both slogans verbatim and no additional marketing lines:
"Financiering op het moment dat het telt."
"Het antwoord terwijl iedereen aan tafel zit."
Other copy only title, revive, palette names/hexes and existing short functional labels. Preserve all brand content and layout quality. The DIFFERENCE is a visible left-to-right pixelated-to-solid transition in the actual wordmark, with R matched to the letter body height.
